description: This file defines an abstract controller class for administrative sub-modules within the Goteo project, handling permissions, filters, URL generation, role checks, and request data processing for admin controllers.

classes.name: AbstractSubController
classes.description: An abstract controller class providing common functionalities for admin sub-modules such as permissions, request handling, filtering, URL generation, and role management.

methods.name: setFilters
methods.description: Sets the filter parameters for the controller, typically used for filtering lists or data views.

methods.name: getFilters
methods.description: Retrieves the current filters, merging defaults and session-stored filters, optionally considering GET parameters.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the controller based on its class name.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label for the controller, optionally for a specific action, with support for translation.

methods.name: getUrl
methods.description: Constructs the URL for the controller, optionally for a specific action and ID.

methods.name: isAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to administer this controller in a specific node.

methods.name: isMasterNode
methods.description: Checks if the current node is the master node.

methods.name: isTranslator
methods.description: Checks if the user has a translator role in the current node.

methods.name: isAdmin
methods.description: Checks if the user has admin privileges in the current node.

methods.name: isSuperAdmin
methods.description: Checks if the user has superadmin privileges in the current node.

methods.name: isRoot
methods.description: Checks if the user is a root user in the current node.

methods.name: getGet
methods.description: Retrieves a GET parameter or the entire query object.

methods.name: hasGet
methods.description: Checks if a GET parameter exists.

methods.name: getPost
methods.description: Retrieves a POST parameter or the entire request object.

methods.name: hasPost
methods.description: Checks if a POST parameter exists.

methods.name: getServer
methods.description: Retrieves a SERVER parameter or server information.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method of the request.

methods.name: isPost
methods.description: Checks if the request method is POST.

methods.name: getReferer
methods.description: Returns the referer URL from request headers.

methods.name: redirect
methods.description: Redirects to a specified URL or the default controller URL.

methods.name: response
methods.description: Generates a response using a view and data.
